"# Implementation Plan - Health App Upgrades & Redesign (APPROVED)

This plan covers implementing a sequential toast queue, sleep/resume detection to reset break times, custom sound downloading/generation, a dedicated preview section in the settings UI, and a general visual redesign of the settings dashboard.

## Approved Decisions & Feedback

- **Queue Delay**: A minimum delay of 1.5 seconds will be enforced between consecutive toast notifications.
- **Sound Storage & Source**: A new folder `HealthApp/resources/sounds/` will be created. We will implement a downloader script to fetch public-domain WAV files, with a robust fallback to high-quality synthetic sound generation if downloads fail.
- **Preview Hub**: The settings UI will feature a live canvas mock showing real-time rendering of the toast design alongside testing buttons.

---

## Proposed Changes

### Core System

#### [MODIFY] [toast_utils.py](file:///c:/Users/NANDHA%20A/Desktop/UTILITIES/toast_utils.py)
- Modify `BaseToast` to integrate with a new global `ToastQueue` thread-safe manager.
- Implement `ToastQueue` inside `BaseToast` that manages queuing and displaying toasts sequentially.
- When `BaseToast.show()` is called, instead of displaying the window immediately, it will add the toast to the queue.
- The queue will process items one by one, showing a toast, waiting for it to be dismissed, and then waiting for 1.5 seconds before showing the next toast.
